pages.text: $(thing)/tilth plot list$() shows every plot. $(thing)here$() and $(thing)info <name>$() describe one, $(thing)rename$() and $(thing)delete$() manage them, and $(thing)addmember$() / $(thing)removemember$() share them.
Plot protection (only owners and members may build or harvest inside) is available but off by default: set plots.protection in the config.
